parts.text: To what extent were research and planning essential in your productions?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Analyse one of your productions in relation to the concept of narrative. 
Section B: Contemporary media issues
Answer one question from Section B.
You should refer to at least two different media and support your answer with reference to contemporary
examples.
Contemporary media regulation

text: Why is regulation of the media so complicated? [50]
OR
‘Contemporary media regulation needs to keep up with new technologies.’ How far do you agree
with this statement? [50]
Global media
‘We are all living in a “global village”, created by the media.’ To what extent do you agree with this
statement? [50]
OR
To what extent have global media transformed audience behaviour? [50]
Media and collective identity
‘Media representations of social groups change over time.’ How far do you agree with this
statement? [50]
OR
Discuss the ways in which identity is mediated. [50]
Media in the online age
Evaluate the different views on the democratising effects of online media. [50]
OR
‘The online age has forced media industries to adapt.’ To what extent do you agree with this
statement? [50]
Postmodern media
What versions of postmodernism have you found useful when analysing the media? [50]
OR
‘Postmodern media texts are more challenging for audiences.’ How far do you agree with this
statement? [50]
